author: abandonXtw
quote: traffic that jams instead of spawning, crowds that react to weather and to each other, a city with its own rhythm you have to learn rather than spawn-camp. That's the unglamorous work — pathfinding, streaming, memory budgets — and it's what separates a map from a place

author: abandonXtw
quote: Combat is one button: lock on, wait for the enemy to finish its little animation, swing. Every boss is the same three-beat loop wearing a new skin. Puzzles alternate between pushing a block and lighting a torch, with a song cue whenever the designers ran out of ideas.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
